items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Billy sometimes worked on the door taking up tickets.

ctx.x:
couple of cars, a truck, or something like that...
Then, see, the reason we left the band was on account of Ross. He was stealing all the money. I knew he was stealing. We just said, "Man, we ain't goin' no further." He was handling the band. He would say it didn't make nothin'. Then he and Billy Coleman, they would work together... Billy sometimes worked on the door taking up tickets. He and the doorman would get together on the door, and they would sell so many tickets for themselves. So they caught up with him…
Was he the guy who used to sometimes take off without getting permission? Not show up or something? Or was that somebody else? Somebody used to take a leave of absence without getting permission.
